question.text: What is the minimum investment per investor to qualify as a Large Value Fund for accredited investors?

explanation.text: The Logic: A Large Value Fund (LVF) for accredited investors is an AIF where each investor invests not less than Rs 25 crores, with the exception of the manager, sponsor, employees, and directors of the AIF or its manager. The Trap: Rs 10 crores is the minimum for special situation fund investors, not for LVFs; Rs 5 crores and Rs 50 crores are unrelated round figures. Note: LVFs have a Rs 25 crores investor minimum and separate concentration-limit relaxations under the AIF Regulations.
